evals.prompt: help me find ways to cut our cloud costs
evals.expected_output: Pulls the billing export or cost-explorer report first instead of optimizing from memory, ranks services and resources by dollar impact, and works top-down since the top five line items usually explain most of the spend variance.

evals.prompt: we bought reserved instances but the bill keeps growing
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses that commitments were likely purchased against peak usage or an unrightsized fleet rather than a measured sustained baseline, and recommends rightsizing before buying further commitments so savings aren't locked in on top of waste.

evals.prompt: let's spend this sprint cleaning up every $10-20/month idle resource we can find
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that a $20/month item isn't worth an engineer's time or a change-review cycle, and redirects to sorting the bill by dollar impact first so the top cost drivers are found before small waste is chased.
